queries.name: modernization-control-repositories
queries.subject: Retained control repositories declaring the Modernization coordinator.
queries.objective: Suggest explicit control-repository selections for authorized Modernization actions.
queries.acceptance: Return one coordinate per retained coordinator repository. This inventory suggests a selection only; it does not authorize actions or establish plan approval or readiness.

queries.name: ops-attention
queries.subject: Latest retained workflow states in the selected scope and horizon.
queries.objective: Inspect blockers, pending review and missing run evidence.
queries.acceptance: Order blocked, review, unknown, then newest observation and identity. Preserve evidence links. Unknown is not idle; pending delivery is not acceptance.

args.value: Latest run state is unknown or no run evidence is retained.

queries.name: ops-in-flight
queries.subject: Retained run attempts with a nonterminal native status.
queries.objective: Inspect the last recorded execution state, not a live queue.
queries.acceptance: Include queued, requested, pending, waiting and native in_progress attempts, retaining compatibility with in-progress; order newest creation then identity. Keep attempts distinct, missing timestamps and links unknown, and completed runs out.

queries.name: ops-repository-work
queries.subject: Latest retained workflow states grouped by control repository.
queries.objective: Compare observed workflow coverage and unresolved work.
queries.acceptance: Count one work item per workflow and native state, keyed by organization and repository. Run coverage counts workflows with a timed latest run, not all attempts or target coverage; untimed evidence is excluded.

queries.name: ops-repositories
queries.subject: Retained repository inventory with latest workflow-state counts.
queries.objective: Find repositories needing investigation without claiming farm health.
queries.acceptance: Keep repositories without workflows; unmatched counts remain null, not zero. Join on organization and repository. Link to repository details and label missing run evidence; no enrollment or live-status claim.

queries.name: ops-recent-outputs
queries.subject: Retained output lifecycle evidence in the selected scope and horizon.
queries.objective: Inspect delivery, adoption basis and survival independently.
queries.acceptance: Order by delivery clock descending then output identity. Preserve producing repository, adoption signal/source and evidence links. Delivery and registry fallback acceptance never imply human acceptance or operational Value.

pages.title: Ops
pages.intent: Give operators an attention-first view of retained farm evidence and explicitly confirmed Modernization actions. Review authoritative native plan and policy previews before dispatch or approval. Installation, rollout changes, merging and deployment remain unavailable.
pages.subject: Retained CAO evidence in the selected scope and horizon.
pages.objective: Investigate farm evidence and review the next authorized Modernization step.
pages.acceptance: Keep retained evidence distinct from current native action checks. Require an explicit, revision-bound confirmation for every plan approval or workflow dispatch. Preserve partial, stale, unavailable and empty evidence; missing evidence is not idle and delivery is not acceptance or Value.
pages.description: Inspect retained farm evidence and review policy-checked Modernization actions.

sections.title: Farm watch and actions
sections.description: Coverage: retained evidence in the selected scope and horizon, not a live queue or a complete enrolled-farm census. Missing evidence is not an idle farm. Delivery and run success are not human acceptance or operational Value; adoption may use a registry delivery fallback.

views.title: Modernization
views.description: Interaction-only native operator controls. Retained inventory suggests control repositories; current policy, plan validation, task readiness, approval and dispatch are owned by the authorized native service, never derived from dashboard evidence.

views.title: Attention needed
views.description: Latest recorded workflow state: blockers first, then pending review, then unknown run evidence. Open the source before deciding what to do.
views.empty-message: No blocked, review or unknown workflow states were observed. Missing or partial coverage does not establish a healthy farm.

views.title: Work in flight
views.description: Last recorded nonterminal run attempts, including GitHub in_progress status. Retained status may be stale; this is not live execution telemetry.
views.empty-message: No nonterminal run attempts are retained in this selection. This does not prove that no work is running.

views.title: Repository status
views.description: Retained control-repository inventory and latest state per workflow, not target enrollment or upstream completeness. Missing counts remain unknown.
views.empty-message: No repository evidence is retained in this selection. Farm coverage is unknown; no operational snapshot may have been ingested yet.

views.title: Recent safe outputs
views.description: Output Lifecycle evidence, newest delivery first. Adoption may be registry-derived rather than a human decision; inspect its basis and source. Survival is separate and is not operational Value.
views.empty-message: No safe-output lifecycle evidence is retained in this selection. Delivery, adoption and operational Value remain unknown.
